facts.fact: The Nigeria Revenue Service article says a system-generated 13-digit Tax ID is automatically generated when a new company registers, and existing businesses retrieve theirs from the NRS Portal.
The article says a company's CAC RC number functions as its NRS identifier and the NRS database is integrated with the CAC from 1 January 2026, so no separate TIN application is needed.
The article says an individual's National Identification Number serves as the NRS identifier, giving a 13-digit Tax ID.
The article states TaxPro Max, the exclusive channel for taxpayer transactions with FIRS, enables taxpayer registration.
The Corporate Affairs Commission says the FIRS tax identification number is electronically generated and endorsed instantly on certificates of newly registered entities.
The Corporate Affairs Commission says the FIRS tax number is issued automatically at business incorporation through the Company Registration Portal, the two agencies' service being fully integrated.

The Federal Inland Revenue Service said the National Identification Number serves automatically as the Tax ID for individuals under the Nigeria Tax Administration Act, due to take effect in January 2026.

The Federal Inland Revenue Service said the Corporate Affairs Commission registration number serves as the Tax ID for registered companies, unifying all tax numbers previously issued by it and the state revenue services.
